text:
Alex Chen: quick question — should we stop returning opaque 429s like `{"error": "rate_limited"}` from the runtime? customers keep asking for a Retry-After and a route hint. thinking we should standardize a small set of machine-readable fields in the body + a couple headers. cc @Priya :thinking:
Priya Patel: +1 to structured hints, but worried about telemetry volume. if we add more enums we need to update metric tagging so Alerting doesn't explode. also need to be careful with PII in hints.
Danilo Ruiz: runtime perspective: emitting an extra small JSON blob is cheap, headers are cheaper. but we already have internal routing reasons (e.g. "quota", "burst-protect", "fallback-model"). exposing those exact strings might leak policy surface. we could map to a public enum.
Mei Wong: from SDK/docs POV clients want consistent retry guidance. prefer a canonical `retry_hint` object in the body: `{ retry_after: secs, reason: "quota" | "throttle" | "overload", route_id: "r-123" }` — SDK can surface friendly copy and console can map reason->badge.
Samir Gupta: console team: we can easily badging reasons if we get `reason` after sampling. proposal: only include `route_id` when `sampling=on` so we don't expose full topologies by default. also want a metric: `error_reason:quota` tag for dashboard aggregation.
Priya Patel: agree on a public enum. telemetry needs pre-agg sampling for high-traffic customers. suggest we sample 0.5% by default but provide opts per-tenant. if we change contract we must version it behind `error_surface_v2` flag.
Alex Chen: versioning makes sense. ops question — is there an outage/rollout risk if clients start depending on `retry_hint`? we should phase it in canary-first in dedicated then hosted.
Danilo Ruiz: plan: add header `X-RW-Retry-After` (seconds) + `X-RW-Reason` (enum) for immediate clients and body `retry_hint` JSON for SDK-friendly parsing. feature gated behind FF: `error_surface_v2`. rollout staged over 2 weeks.
Mei Wong: SDKs can fallback — if headers exist prefer headers for minimal parsing, else body. add a small changelog and console flag toggle. also we need example responses in docs + translators for i18n copy in console.
Samir Gupta: dashboard: add a new widget `Client Fail Reason` which groups by `error_reason` and shows rate/5m. also a runbook link per reason. default alert if `error_reason:quota` > 3% for 10m.
Priya Patel: re: instrumentation: we must add `status_category` metric (success, client_error, server_error, throttle) and ensure `X-RW-Reason` maps to it. Also add schema to internal events so long-term storage doesn't explode.
Alex Chen: privacy note: do not include tenant IDs or prompt snippets in hints. only route ids and enums. add a docs note for security review.
ops-bot: feature-flag `error_surface_v2` created by @Danilo.rollouts, default=false, owners=[eng-platform, sdk, console].
Danilo Ruiz: I'll draft the PR: runtime + header emit + FF + small telemetry mapping. will add unit tests for header precedence.
Mei Wong: I'll queue SDK PR to read headers first, body second, and update changelogs.
Priya Patel: I'll add sampling config and alert tweaks to infra playbook.
Alex Chen: thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10am to confirm rollout plan. TL:DR: deprecate opaque 429s in favor of small standardized hints (headers + body) behind FF + sampled telemetry + console badging. :thumbsup:
